messages.subject: Project Indigo - Licence Agreement v3
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan, Amelia,

Our counter attached (tracked against v1, showing the agreed position). We have met you on the liability cap (150%) and the nine-month sell-off. On royalty we have landed at 4.5% - this is the number our client can accept and reflects the value of the exclusive field-of-use grant. We have also tightened the audit-cost trigger from a 5% to a 3% underpayment. Subject to those, we think we are there.

Best wishes,
Elena

Elena Marchetti | Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
